title: Why We Refuse to Let the LLM Authorize Its Own Tools
hook: The model reasons. The runtime authorizes. Never the reverse.
thesis: When the model says 'I should follow this account,' PING treats it as a proposal. Deterministic machinery then asks: is this the correct principal, is the target resolved, does the account control exist, is the capability granted, is it inside policy and budget, is it a duplicate, already pending, is state known, does the provider support it. Only then does execution happen. The episode makes this the signature separation: intelligence proposes, deterministic authority decides, evidence proves what happened.

proven: The directive defines the proposal pipeline: model proposes, deterministic capability/policy/budget checks gate, adapter executes, independent observation verifies (sections 9, 35).
The directive's central position sentence: 'Intelligence proposes. Deterministic authority decides. Evidence proves what happened.' (section 35).
